text: {"lessons":["I made no trades through period 5, but my account still fell 10.6% from period 1. I'll check whether my holdings still fit my risk tolerance even when I don't plan to trade.","I sold shares in periods 6 and 9 well below my average cost. Next time, I'll ask whether I'd want to own each stock at today's price rather than waiting to break even.","The 2.4% rebound in period 10 left my account about 15% below period 1. I won't take one good month as a reason to add risk."]}
